items.title: Mesh Hero Card
items.description: Vibrant dynamic mesh background scene with organically floating OKLCH color blobs and a glassmorphic hero callout.
items.recipe: The soft iridescent mesh is composed of several large geometric elements (.blob) colored in the OKLCH space, continuously moving and rotating along separate trajectory paths. The parent container with filter: blur(70px) organically blends them into a fluid gradient without muddy bleeding artifacts.

items.title: Glitch Cyber Buttons
items.description: Cyberpunk HUD panel with three angular clip-path buttons that RGB-split and glitch on hover, framed by scanlines and corner brackets.
items.recipe: The polygon-chamfered silhouette is sculpted via clip-path: polygon(). The RGB split glitch effect is driven by two pseudoelements (::before, ::after) cloning the button text, offset slightly horizontally and clipped to thin slices with clip-path: inset() using a rapid steps() keyframe loop.

items.title: Orbit Border Button
items.description: Call-to-action button with rotating conic-gradient border powered by CSS @property and an outer glowing duplicate blur.
items.recipe: The core mechanism relies on registering the custom CSS property @property --angle { syntax: '<angle>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0deg; }. This allows smooth keyframe animation of the conic gradient rotation angle. A blurred duplicate pseudoelement placed behind generates the dynamic glowing aura.

items.title: Glass-4 · Hazy Segmented Border
items.description: Result panel: big timer, badge and three stat tiles, with a dark/light theme switch.
items.recipe: The non-uniform glowing border is achieved with a conic-gradient on a ::before pseudoelement with 1px padding, hollowed out via mask-composite: exclude (content-box XOR border-box). The atmospheric inner haze uses ::after with negative insets, 3 radial gradients, and blur(25px). In light mode, border segment saturation is lowered rather than inverted, preserving genuine glass physics.

items.title: Holo Foil Card
items.description: 3D interactive collectible card with pointer-tracking tilt, iridescent holographic sheen, and dynamic specular glare.
items.recipe: As the cursor moves, tilt angles (--rx, --ry) and glare origins (--px, --py) are calculated in real time. The holographic rainbow shimmer is created with a conic/linear spectrum overlay using mix-blend-mode: color-dodge, while a moving specular radial gradient mimics ambient light reflection.

items.title: Khaki Obsidian Pitch Deck Card
items.description: Ultra pitch-black card with deep murky swamp/khaki green haze glow, matte borders, and tactile telemetry widgets.
items.recipe: The interface achieves a profound dark mode by using true OLED pitch-black (#040604) rather than slate gray. A deep murky moss-green atmospheric haze is generated via multiple layered radial gradients and a 30px gaussian blur on ::after. Border segments use subtle olive/khaki gradients with mask-composite: exclude.

items.title: Solar Flare Sunset Black Card
items.description: Pitch-black dashboard card bathed in an intense golden-hour solar flare haze, radiant amber rim light, and warm gradient typography.
items.recipe: The sunrise/sunset atmosphere is achieved by placing an expansive multi-color radial gradient (amber #ff9e00 to incandescent orange #ff4500 and deep purple) on a blurred ::after layer behind an absolute pitch-black (#040302) container. The upper rim features an acute conic highlight simulating direct sunlight glancing off chamfered glass.

items.title: Spotlight Card Grid
items.description: Interactive card grid where moving the cursor illuminates borders and textures across neighboring cards synchronously.
items.recipe: A pointermove listener on the parent container computes cursor coordinates relative to each card (--mouse-x, --mouse-y). Each card's ::before layer renders a radial gradient positioned at those coordinates, masked to the border perimeter. Neighboring cards are lit synchronously by a single unified beam of light.

items.title: Cyberpunk Terminal Search & Command Input
items.description: Tactical command palette input bar with slash command autocomplete tags, hotkey indicators, and neon scanline status bar.
items.recipe: The command search bar combines an elevated dark obsidian chassis with an animated neon cyan outline upon focus-within. It contains clickable quick-action chips that dynamically prepend commands (such as /search, /deploy, /config) directly into the input stream.

items.title: Glassmorphic Auth & OTP Input Form
items.description: Tactile frosted glass sign-in card with floating label inputs, automatic multi-box OTP verification codes, and focus glow rings.
items.recipe: The authentication card employs modern floating labels using the :not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label selector pattern to animate labels without JavaScript. The 4-digit OTP code inputs automatically advance focus on digit entry and highlight the active cell with an animated cyan ring.

items.title: Signal Loaders Pack
items.description: Curated collection of 6 distinctive telemetry loaders: radar sweep, oscilloscope wave, segmented LCD bar, conic ring, pulsing core, and orbiting dots.
items.recipe: Each telemetry loader demonstrates a distinct CSS animation technique: from rotating radar sweep sectors (conic-gradient mask) and oscilloscope sine waves (SVG stroke-dashoffset) to segmented LCD equalizer meters with staggered discrete animation-delay offsets.

items.title: Scroll-Driven Reveal Feed
items.description: Dark editorial feed: cards rise and unblur as they enter the viewport, plus a glowing reading-progress bar at the top.
items.recipe: Standard CSS keyframe animations are bound to scroll position: animation-timeline: view() drives the reveal while the card enters the viewport (animation-range: entry 0% cover 30%), while scroll(root) drives the sticky top progress bar. In browsers without support, an IntersectionObserver fallback activates the .in class.

items.title: Soft Toggle Set
items.description: Light neumorphic settings panel: 4 springy toggles + segmented mode picker; the panel accent reacts to checked state.
items.recipe: Neumorphic tactile depth is crafted with dual opposing box-shadows: a bright specular highlight top-left and a soft dark shadow bottom-right. State is managed purely with modern CSS: .panel:has(#t-focus:checked) redefines the --accent variable. The springy knob bounce is defined via linear() easing with graceful cubic-bezier fallback.

items.title: CRT Terminal Window
items.description: Retro hacker terminal window with phosphor green glow, curved screen vignette, animated scanlines, and typewriter output.
items.recipe: The CRT monitor appearance is produced by combining a peripheral radial-gradient vignette (simulating glass screen curvature) with an overlay repeating-linear-gradient for cathode ray scanlines. The phosphor green glow uses layered text-shadows, while the command prompt cursor blinks discretely with steps(1).

items.title: Frosted Grain Dialog
items.description: Native modal dialog featuring frosted glass aesthetics, SVG feTurbulence tactile grain noise, and top-layer transition-behavior animations.
items.recipe: The modal opens via the native HTML5 .showModal() API. Smooth top-layer entry transitions are animated with @starting-style and transition-behavior: allow-discrete. The tactile frosted glass grain texture is rendered by an inline SVG feTurbulence fractal noise filter composited with mix-blend-mode: overlay.

items.title: Glass Dock Menu
items.description: macOS inspired floating glass dock menu featuring neighbor icon magnification powered by modern CSS :has() selectors.
items.recipe: The graduated neighbor icon magnification without JavaScript is powered by pure CSS: combining :hover with the next-sibling selector (.item:hover + .item) and previous-sibling selector via :has() (.item:has(+ .item:hover)). The floating frosted glass dock chassis features backdrop-filter: blur(24px).

items.title: 8-bit Pixel Menu
items.description: Arcade 8-bit game main menu with stepped pixel border shadows, blinking cursor arrow, and keyboard navigation.
items.recipe: The authentic 8-bit stepped pixel border is constructed using multiple zero-blur box-shadow offsets, rendering pixelated stepped corners without external images. The blinking triangle cursor is controlled by keyboard Up/Down/Enter keys with discrete steps(1) animation.

items.title: Segmented Nav with Sliding Pill
items.description: Sleek glass segmented control with an active indicator pill that smoothly glides between options using CSS transitions.
items.recipe: The active sliding pill indicator is positioned dynamically using CSS custom properties --pill-left and --pill-width, smoothly transitioning with cubic-bezier curves when tabs change. The glass container features backdrop-filter: blur(20px) and a subtle top-edge specular highlight.

items.title: Chromatic Glitch RGB Split Typography
items.description: Distorted analog RGB-split chromatic glitch typography with horizontal scan slice tears and jitter displacement keyframes.
items.recipe: The chromatic aberration glitch is created without duplicating DOM nodes by utilizing data-text attributes on ::before and ::after pseudoelements. One layer carries a pure cyan text-shadow, the other red-magenta. Rapid @keyframes loops apply randomized clip-path: inset() horizontal slice windows, producing genuine VHS tracking tears.

items.title: Deep Liquid Sheen Metallic Typography
items.description: Liquid chrome specular typography featuring an animated gradient shimmer mask, 3D extruded lighting, and reflective edge bevels.
items.recipe: Liquid metal typography is crafted by applying a multi-stop metallic linear gradient across background-clip: text with an animated background-position loop. A high-pass filter drop-shadow gives physical 3D extrusion while keeping text fully selectable and accessible.

items.title: Neon Signboard Glow Typography
items.description: Authentic neon tube signboard typography with multi-layer luminous text-shadows, gas discharge bloom, and realistic intermittent flicker.
items.recipe: The authentic neon sign glow is engineered by combining five layered text-shadows ranging from a crisp white core to wide saturated neon magenta and violet halos. A sporadic @keyframes flicker animation randomly drops text opacity, simulating an irregular electrical discharge inside a noble gas neon tube.

items.title: AE86 Retro Digital Dash Cluster
items.description: Authentic Japanese 1980s digital instrument cluster featuring rising segmented tachometer curve, digital speedometer, chime warning, and switchable amber/green/cyan/white backlighting.
items.recipe: The iconic 1980s JDM digital cluster simulates an arched segmented tachometer using stepped flex bars and ghost 7-segment numbers. The entire cluster backlight color palette is controlled by a set of root CSS variables (--dash-glow, --dash-lit, --dash-ghost), allowing instant switching between authentic Amber (Toyota), Neo-Green, Synth-Cyan, and Ice-White.

items.title: Dynamic Island HUD
items.description: Morphing pill HUD inspired by iOS Dynamic Island with compact, media player, weather, and call states.
items.recipe: The morphing pill dynamically interpolates its dimensions and internal layout across states (compact, weather, player, call) using physics-inspired linear() easing. Sub-views transition seamlessly with coordinated opacity and transform scale keyframes.

items.title: LCD Stopwatch
items.description: Retro LCD stopwatch device: ghost-segment display, glow, scanlines, start/stop/lap/reset buttons and a lap list.
items.recipe: The authentic LCD display trick stacks two layers of the DSEG7 font in a single CSS grid cell: a dim ghost segment background reading 88:88.88 underneath, and bright illuminated digits on top. Because all DSEG glyphs share identical metrics, segments align perfectly with multi-layered text-shadow phosphor glow and scanlines.

items.title: Paper Notification Stack
items.description: Tactile light-mode notification cards stacked with realistic layered paper shadows that fan out gracefully upon interaction.
items.recipe: Tactile stacked paper cards are created using progressive transform: translateY() scale() offsets paired with subtle multi-layer box-shadows. Hovering over the stack fans out the cards smoothly, while clicking dismisses the active top card with an exit swipe transition.

items.title: Tactical Police Radar HUD
items.description: Handheld police Doppler speed radar interface: sweep scope, speed lock, digital 7-segment readout, and audio-visual violation alert.
items.recipe: The police Doppler radar combines an active 360-degree sweep scope (conic-gradient beam with target blips) and a dual-layer DSEG7 digital speed readout. Exceeding the speed limit triggers an attention-grabbing strobing VIOLATION / LOCKED status alert.

items.title: Orbital Space Navigation HUD
items.description: Futuristic orbital spacecraft cockpit HUD with gyro pitch ladder, planet target lock reticle, thrust throttle, and warp trajectory vector.
items.recipe: The sci-fi spacecraft HUD is composed of an interactive pitch horizon ladder and a rotating target reticle. Crisp vector optics are styled with semi-transparent cyan strokes, bracket borders, and monospace flight telemetry. Clicking the throttle adjusts warp engine velocity with visual shockwave pulses.

items.title: Vintage Car Radio Head Unit
items.description: Tactile automotive stereo head unit with knurled rotary knobs, mechanical preset push-buttons, cassette slot, and 14-segment amber VFD display.
items.recipe: The physical tactile aesthetic is achieved with knurled rotary knobs (radial teeth textured with repeating-conic-gradient) supporting interactive vertical pointer dragging. The 14-segment amber VFD display uses DSEG14 with warm phosphor text-shadow glow, unlit ghost segments, and scanlines.
